status: PROPOSED (ODR-R10-05): becomes binding when the owner pins this file's sha256 as designContract.contractSha256 in the lock
description: The governed design contract (adversarial audit R5). Static half: requirements-compiler design-contract. Rendered half: verification/design-contract/rendered.spec.mjs from the governed checkout. Roles list every name an approved Forma version uses, so a newer compatible Forma passes once its names are added here under owner review.
themeBoundary: A literal colour (hex, rgb(), hsl()) may appear only as the value of a custom-property definition in a theme file (a CSS file whose path contains 'theme'). Elsewhere colours are var(--…) of a defined token or a pinned Forma property; var() fallbacks are allowed. Derived shades are allowed (UI-016 'derived foreground, hover, disabled, border and dark-mode tokens').
independentVisualReview: UI-016-O16: the owner reviews the screenshots the rendered check publishes; the automated verdict is not that review.
